name: messages-department-en
query: Send a SAP message to everyone in the {department_name} department: stock count on Friday at 9.
expected_behavior: Resolves the department and its member users (UserCodes) from live data
Lists the resolved recipients and the text, and stops to ask the user to confirm before sending
The proposed message goes to every resolved member as an internal SAP message, with no email fan-out since the user didn't ask for one
Does not invent UserCodes or treat an authorization UserGroup as the department
